To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have found evidence for CP violation in the B 0 decay channel.
we have observed the first evidence for CP violation in the B meson system.

(1) the polarization in the B → J/ ψ K ∗ decay was measured for the first time; (2) this result demonstrates that the B → J / ψ K ∗ channel is suitable for CP violation studies; and (3) the result of the measurement of the polarization is consistent with theoretical expectations and with the results of other experiments.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of CP-violating asymmetries in B-meson decays.
the measurement of the polarization in exclusive decay B 0 →J/ψK ∂0.
the development of a new method for the measurement of polarization in the B → J/ΨK∗ decay channel.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this is the first observation of the polarization of the B 0 meson in B 0 → K ∗0 J/ψ decays.
the polarization in the B → J/psi K* decay channel is consistent with zero.
the polarization in B → J/ΨK∗ decays is not well understood and that further measurements and studies of this decay channel are necessary.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have measured polarization in B0 → J/ΨK∗ decay and the ratio of the transversal width and the total decay width of B0 → J/Psi K∗0 decay.
we have measured the polarization in the exclusive decay channel B → J/psiK* and found that the ratio of the transversal width to the total width is ΓT/Γ=0.03±.16±.15.
we have measured the polarization in B → J/Ψ K* decay.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to measure the polarization in B → J/psi K ∗ using ARGUS detector data.
the decay width is not a function of the total decay width.
the decay B → J ψ K ∗ has a small polarization.
